body.statement: Whenever \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)\ne\varnothing\), on every nonempty stratum with \(0\le\gamma\le\kappa_\star/2\), \(\mathfrak A(\gamma)\asymp1\), uniformly in \(T_0,T_1\). In the specialization \(N=3,r=s=1\), at \(\gamma=\kappa_\star=1/\sqrt3\), for every nonempty endpoint stratum and \(T_0\ge\overline T\), \(\mathfrak A(1/\sqrt3)\asymp\rho_{\mathrm{ad}}(1/\sqrt3)/\min\{B,T_1^{-1/2}\}\). Along unsaturated sequences with \(T_0,T_1\to\infty\) and \(T_1/T_0\to\infty\), this endpoint ratio has order \(1+A\sqrt{T_1/T_0}\) under the fixed-class constants. No ratio formula is asserted on the unresolved intermediate-margin region.
body.justification: The stated ratio records only the weak-margin and certified endpoint regimes supported by matching oracle results.
body.gap: No cited panel or sparse-confidence paper derives both the no-penalty weak-margin region and the finite-classification maximal-margin gap in this original panel experiment.
body.consumer: The ratio is a decision rule for whether collecting more pre periods or supplying a credible loading-margin restriction can improve uncertainty in an interference analysis.
